content: अरम् {%ind.%} <ab>Ved.</ab> [ऋ-अम्] .²1 Swiftly, near, at hand, present. अरं राजगिरिं याहि पाहि राज्यं निजं नृप <ls>Śiva B. 26. 45</ls>. .²2 Readily, fitly, suitably, so as to answer some purpose. .²3 Enough, sufficiently (<ab>cf.</ab> अलम्); excessively; पुरु वारं पुरु त्मना <ls>Rv. 1. 142. 10</ls>.
